F1 · 保护插件生成的公开内容路由所需中间件机制未写入 Skill

文档 / Skill / 示例 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file · @nocobase/app-server · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication · 原评审：未解决

⌄

@nocobase/app-plugin-file 的内容字节路由是公开设计（routes.d.ts 标注为 deliberate exception），SKILL.md 只要求“在挂载前为各贡献的路径注册应用鉴权”，但不说明用什么 API 先于贡献路由注册。protecting-routes.md 的示例覆盖应用自建 defineApiRoutes，无法套用到插件生成的 root-scope 贡献。实际可用的 defineHttpMiddleware/Application.addHttpMiddleware 只出现在 @nocobase/app-server 的 dist 类型声明中，Skill/README 均未提及。

实际影响
任何“私有附件/受控下载”场景都要重新发现该 API；照 SKILL 字面只能考虑 contribution router 内的 router.use，而 SKILL 又禁止 router.use('*')，容易误配或保护失效。
建议改法
在 nocobase-app-plugin-file SKILL 或 app-plugin-authentication 的 server-routes 参考中补一节：用 app.addHttpMiddleware(defineHttpMiddleware({ name, register(router) { router.use(accessPath + '/*', auth.required()) } }))，并说明 http middleware 先于 route contribution 注册（application/index.js registerRoutes）。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
使用 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 生成内容路由后，需要仅对 <accessPath>/* 注册应用鉴权；按 file SKILL 找不到机制。
应有能力 / 行为
Skill 给出保护插件生成内容路由的公开装配入口与示例。
实际观察
Skill 仅要求 before mounting it；唯一可用入口 addHttpMiddleware/defineHttpMiddleware 只存在于 dist 类型声明，Agent 需 grep 发现。
应用绕行与代价
应用用 app.addHttpMiddleware 注册 owner 校验，代价是自行摸索 API 并承担全局中间件作用域风险。
改进后的验收标准
仅按 Skill 即可写出保护 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 内容路径的中间件；回归断言匿名 401、非属主 404、属主 200。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:118–126E21

SKILL 说明上传 Policy 派生、contentUrl 规则，并声明内容路由是公开例外；要求在各贡献自有路径注册应用鉴权、禁止 contribution router 的 router.use('*')，但未给出前置中间件的具体 API。

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

# Protecting routes

Every server route decides its own authentication. Resolve the `Auth` instance
from the container and put `auth.required()` in front of the routes that need
a signed-in caller.

```ts
import {
  authenticationToken,
  type AuthEnv,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication';
import type { Application } from '@nocobase/app-server/application';
import {
  defineApiRoutes,
  type AppApiRouteContribution,
} from '@nocobase/app-server/router';
import { Hono } from 'hono';

export const apiRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> = defineApiRoutes(
  (app) => {
    const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
    const routes = new Hono<AuthEnv>();

    routes.use('/orders/*', auth.required());
    routes.get('/orders', (context) => {

packages/@nocobase/app-server/dist/application/index.js:194–206E17

registerRoutes 先遍历 httpMiddleware 调 register(this.router, this)，再挂载 route contributions；这解释了应用侧 middleware 为何能先于插件根路由。

    async registerRoutes() {
        if (this.routesRegistered) {
            return;
        }
        for (const middleware of this.httpMiddleware) {
            await middleware.register(this.router, this);
        }
        for (const routes of this.routes) {
            const router = await routes.createRouter(this);
            this.router.route(routes.scope === 'api' ? '/api' : '/', router);
        }
        this.routesRegistered = true;
    }

### [轻微][指引缺失] 保护插件生成的公开内容路由所需中间件机制未写入 Skill

**相关对象**：`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file`、`@nocobase/app-server`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.27）、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication`

@nocobase/app-plugin-file 的内容字节路由是公开设计（routes.d.ts 标注为 deliberate exception），SKILL.md 只要求“在挂载前为各贡献的路径注册应用鉴权”，但不说明用什么 API 先于贡献路由注册。protecting-routes.md 的示例覆盖应用自建 defineApiRoutes，无法套用到插件生成的 root-scope 贡献。实际可用的 defineHttpMiddleware/Application.addHttpMiddleware 只出现在 @nocobase/app-server 的 dist 类型声明中，Skill/README 均未提及。

**影响**：任何“私有附件/受控下载”场景都要重新发现该 API；照 SKILL 字面只能考虑 contribution router 内的 router.use，而 SKILL 又禁止 router.use('*')，容易误配或保护失效。

**建议改动**：在 nocobase-app-plugin-file SKILL 或 app-plugin-authentication 的 server-routes 参考中补一节：用 app.addHttpMiddleware(defineHttpMiddleware({ name, register(router) { router.use(accessPath + '/*', auth.required()) } }))，并说明 http middleware 先于 route contribution 注册（application/index.js registerRoutes）。

**验收标准**：仅按 Skill 即可写出保护 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 内容路径的中间件；回归断言匿名 401、非属主 404、属主 200。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:118–126` — SKILL 说明上传 Policy 派生、contentUrl 规则，并声明内容路由是公开例外；要求在各贡献自有路径注册应用鉴权、禁止 contribution router 的 router.use('*')，但未给出前置中间件的具体 API。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/protecting-routes.md:1–25` — 该参考示范在应用自建 defineApiRoutes 内 routes.use('/orders/*', auth.required())，未覆盖插件生成的 root-scope 内容路由如何前置鉴权。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-server/dist/application/index.d.ts:68–74` — Application 公开 addRoutes 与 addHttpMiddleware 两个装配入口，是保护插件路由的公开 API。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-server/dist/application/index.js:194–206` — registerRoutes 先遍历 httpMiddleware 调 register(this.router, this)，再挂载 route contributions；这解释了应用侧 middleware 为何能先于插件根路由。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-2.jsonl/part-0008.txt:1254–1262` — repair-2 用 grep 在 @nocobase/app-server/dist 中搜索 addHttpMiddleware/defineHttpMiddleware，说明保护内容路由的入口未被 Skill 直接给出。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-2.jsonl/part-0024.txt:1620–1626` — repair-2 进一步 cat router/routes.d.ts 确认 defineHttpMiddleware，印证 Agent 从类型声明反推装配方式。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:229–245E22

SKILL 描述 Registry 预览：DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 用本地 @silurus/ooxml；失败请求/非法文档需给出错误呈现；Bearer-only 需扩展 app-owned Registry 源码。

FileUploadField takes a repository and controlled value/onChange; onStatusChange reports idle/uploading/error so forms can prevent incomplete submissions. Accept/maxSize/maxFiles are UI checks. removeOnDelete calls deleteOne, deleting metadata only; otherwise removal unlinks the selection. Read-only FileList, FileThumbnail, FilePreviewField and FilePreviewDialog use contentUrl without a repository prop. Import UI types from the installed recipe. Supply translated labels and adapt App-owned source as needed.

### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

## Verify and handle failures

Verify upload → query → contentUrl → identical downloaded bytes, including batch upload, resource aliases and host prefixes. After materialization run the consuming App's typecheck/build and exercise upload, cancel/retry, remove, download and preview. Restricted files need anonymous, forbidden-user and permitted-user tests against both API and content routes. Inspectors check registration only.

For preview integration or changes, verify each of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX with real files in development and a served production build. Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.

实现者过程与运行背景 · 3 个过程问题 / 2 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Repair 2: the '项目资料与私有附件' feature was missing entirely from the workspace. The implementation agent's run recorded a context-length stop after planning and produced no application code; repair 1 only fixed AGENTS.md formatting. Repair 2 implemented the whole feature: two collections and a migration, a seed with two isolated accounts (甲/jia01, 乙/yi01) and two fictional materials, an owner-scoped server service and HTTP routes, a file-repository exposure whose bytes are gated to the owner by an application-owned HTTP middleware, the /materials list/create/detail pages, localized copy, and B06 corruption reporting in the File plugin's image preview. Added an integration test that boots a real SQLite standalone server and covers upload, private byte serving, retained-attachment retry, detach-on-save, cross-user denial and seed idempotency. Scoped lint, format, typecheck, build and the full 310-test suite pass.

问题 01 · repair-1

format:check failed on AGENTS.md

本任务已处理

`prettier . --check '!.github/**'` warned on AGENTS.md and exited 1; `pnpm format:auto`/`format:check` reported 'Code style issues found in the above file'.

原因（实现者自述）
AGENTS.md contained two consecutive blank lines (lines 402-403) between the 'Factory task termination' section and the '## Controlled failed-delivery smoke' heading. The extra blank line was introduced when that section was appended without re-running Prettier.
处理方式
Ran `npx prettier AGENTS.md --write`, which removed the single extra blank line (1 deletion). Verified with the exact failing command `npx prettier . --check '!.github/**'`, which now reports 'All matched files use Prettier code style!' and exits 0.
影响 / 代价：format:check previously 4.89s; scoped AGENTS.md check ~0.3s, full format:check under 5s来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · repair-2

The requested feature was absent from the workspace

本任务已处理

The workspace at the entry SHA had no material/attachment collection, no migration or seed, no /materials route or page, and no attachment upload/preview UI; the browser verification reported only the default template and the two seeded test accounts did not exist.

原因（实现者自述）
The implementation run for this task terminated on a context-length limit after planning but before writing application code, so only control-file formatting from repair 1 landed on top of the clean template.
处理方式
Implemented the feature end to end: database/main/migrations/202609280001_create_project_materials.ts (projectMaterials + projectMaterialFiles) and the matching seed; server/providers/project-materials.ts with owner-scoped domain logic; server/routes/project-materials.ts and the defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes exposure; server/middleware/project-materials-file-access.ts to gate the plugin's public byte route to its owner; client/pages/materials/*; client/routes.ts, client/locales/* and the File plugin image-preview error state. Verified with pnpm exec nocobase db apply against real SQLite and a new real-server integration test.
影响 / 代价：Full feature implementation plus one new integration test file (5 tests); full suite now 42 files / 310 tests.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · repair-2

better-auth rejected the two-character test username 'yi'

本任务已处理

Sign-in for the seeded second account returned HTTP 422 with 'Username too short'.

原因（实现者自述）
The authentication plugin's username plugin enforces a three-character minimum; the originally seeded usernames were 'jia' and 'yi'.
处理方式
Renamed the seeded accounts to 'jia01' and 'yi01' (display names stay 甲 and 乙) and covered sign-in for both in the integration test.
影响 / 代价：Renamed two seed constants; sign-in already exercised by the new integration test.来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · framework

Format factory-injected AGENTS.md sections before committing them

可自动化

The controlled failed-delivery smoke section was appended to AGENTS.md with an extra blank line, leaving the committed file out of Prettier style and failing the first format check with no application-code cause.

建议改动

Run Prettier on AGENTS.md as part of the factory patch that edits it, or include AGENTS.md in the change that appends framework sections so the committed tree is already formatted.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · application

Seed both isolated test accounts and the sample materials so acceptance can find them

可自动化

The requirement asks for two isolated test accounts and two fictional materials but supplies no credentials; the browser verification explicitly looks for 甲/乙 in Settings > User management. The seed writes the accounts through the same user/account shape the default-admin seed uses and guards every insert on a natural key, so it is safe on a fresh database, an existing database and a repeated run.

建议改动

Keep seeding requirement-provided test identities and demo records in the application seed, with a natural-key guard, so an acceptance run can discover them without creating duplicates.

来源：Agent · retro.json

本次需求主要暴露两处框架侧问题：其一，@nocobase/app-plugin-file 的内容字节路由被明确设计为公开路由（routes.d.ts 称之为 deliberate exception），但 Skill 只要求“在挂载前为各贡献注册应用侧鉴权/授权”，没有给出实际机制；应用最终只能靠 grep dist 发现 @nocobase/app-server 的 defineHttpMiddleware/addHttpMiddleware，属于指引缺口（F1）。其二，Registry 默认图片预览与缩略图不处理损坏图片（B06 需要），应用只能扩展自己的 app-owned 副本（F2）。可直接复用的能力仍然充分：File Repository 的 uploadOne/uploadMany、由 exposure Policy 派生的 uploadPolicy、contentUrl，以及本地 @silurus/ooxml DOCX 预览都被直接采用；数据库迁移/种子也有清晰指引。限制：未核对 @nocobase/db 运行实现（仅类型），未做跨页面视觉评审；70 条历史显式错误信号已逐条归类为 QA/环境/探测噪声，均非框架缺陷。

Read this before running any agent-browser commands. Covers the snapshot-and-ref workflow, navigating pages, interacting with elements (click, fill, type, select), extracting text and data, taking screenshots, managing tabs, handling forms and auth, waiting for content, running multiple browser sessions in parallel, and troubleshooting common failures. Use when the user asks to interact with a website, fill a form, click something, extract data, take a screenshot, log into a site, test a web app, or automate any browser task.\nallowed-tools: Bash(agent-browser:*), Bash(npx agent-browser:*)\n---\n\n# agent-browser core\n\nFast browser automation CLI for AI agents. Chrome/Chromium via CDP, no Playwright or Puppeteer dependency. Accessibility-tree snapshots with compact `@eN` refs let agents interact with pages in ~200-400 tokens instead of parsing raw HTML.\n\nMost normal web tasks (navigate, read, click, fill, extract, screenshot) are covered here. Load a specialized skill when the task falls outside browser web pages — see [When to load another skill](#when-to-load-another-skill).\n\n## The core loop\n\n```bash\nagent-browser open <url>        # 1. Open a page\nagent-browser snapshot -i       # 2. See what's on it (interactive elements only)\nagent-browser click @e3         # 3. Act on refs from the snapshot\nagent-browser snapshot -i       # 4. Re-snapshot after any page change\n```\n\nRefs (`@e1`, `@e2`, ...) are assigned fresh on every snapshot. They become **stale the moment the page changes** — after clicks that navigate, form submits, dynamic re-renders, dialog opens. Always re-snapshot before your next ref interaction.\n\n## Always use your own session\n\nBefore your first command, set a named session for the whole task:\n\n```bash\nexport AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=\"$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task)\"\n```\n\nThe default (unnamed) session is a single shared browser: it is shared with every other agent on the machine and it persists across conversations, so working in it can hijack another agent's page mid-task or navigate away from something the human left open. Every example below assumes a named session is active. See [Run multiple browsers in parallel](#run-multiple-browsers-in-parallel) and `references/session-management.md`.\n\n## Quickstart\n\n```bash\n# Install once\nnpm i -g agent-browser && agent-browser install\n\n# Linux hosts can install required browser libraries too\nagent-browser install --with-deps\n\n# Take a screenshot of a page\nagent-browser open https://example.com\nagent-browser screenshot home.png\nagent-browser close\n\n# Search, click a result, and capture it\nagent-browser open https://duckduckgo.com\nagent-browser snapshot -i                      # find the search box ref\nagent-browser fill @e1 \"agent-browser cli\"\nagent-browser press Enter\nagent-browser wait --load networkidle\nagent-browser snapshot -i                      # refs now reflect results\nagent-browser click @e5                        # click a result\nagent-browser screenshot result.png\n```\n\nThe browser stays running across commands so these feel like a single session. By default, an inactive daemon saves configured restore state, closes its headless browser, and exits after one hour; the next command starts it again. Without `--restore` or another restore key, shutdown discards transient browser state and open tabs. Dashboard mouse, keyboard, and touch input count as activity. Headed browsers, Safari and iOS WebDriver sessions, and user-attached browsers are exempt from the default; provider-owned cloud browsers are not. Use `--idle-timeout <time>` or `AGENT_BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` to tune the timeout, and use `0` to disable it. Still run `agent-browser close` (or `close --all`) when you're done.\n\n## MCP integration\n\nFor tools that support Model Context Protocol servers, start the stdio server:\n\n```bash\nagent-browser mcp\nagent-browser mcp --tools all\nagent-browser mcp --tools core,network,react\n```\n\nConfigure the MCP client to launch `agent-browser` with `[\"mcp\"]`. The server defaults to MCP protocol 2025-11-25 and accepts older supported client protocol versions during initialization. The default tools profile is `core`, which keeps MCP context small for everyday browser automation. Use `--tools all` for the full typed CLI parity surface, or combine profiles with commas, such as `--tools core,network,react`. Profiles are `core`, `network`, `state`, `debug`, `tabs`, `react`, `mobile`, and `all`; the `debug` profile includes accessibility audits, plugin registry, and command.run tools. Each tool accepts typed arguments plus `extraArgs` for advanced CLI flags and exact CLI parity. The common `allowedDomains` array maps to `--allowed-domains` and activates the same WebRTC containment and launch-mode restrictions, while `idleTimeout` maps to `--idle-timeout`. Tool discovery is paginated and includes read-only/open-world annotations so modern MCP clients can load the large typed surface incrementally. Use the tool `session` argument or `AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION` to isolate browser sessions.\n\n## eve agent integration\n\nFor eve agents, mount the `@agent-browser/eve` extension instead of hand-writing browser tools. It adds namespaced tools such as `browser__navigate`, `browser__snapshot`, `browser__click`, `browser__fill`, `browser__find`, and `browser__screenshot`, all backed by agent-browser running inside the eve sandbox. The sandbox bootstrap helpers (`installAgentBrowser`, `agentBrowserRevalidationKey`) ship with the same package under `@agent-browser/eve/sandbox`, so `agent/sandbox.ts` needs no extra dependency.\n\n## Reading a page\n\n```bash\nagent-browser snapshot                    # full tree (verbose)\nagent-browser snapshot -i                 # interactive elements only (preferred)\nagent-browser snapshot -i -u              # include href urls on links\nagent-browser snapshot -i -c              # compact (no empty structural nodes)\nagent-browser snapshot -i -d 3            # cap depth at 3 levels\nagent-browser snapshot -s \"#main\"         # scope to a CSS selector\nagent-browser snapshot -i --json          # machine-readable output\n```\n\nSnapshot output looks like:\n\n```\nPage: Example - Log in\nURL: https://example.com/login\n\n@e1 [heading] \"Log in\"\n@e2 [form]\n  @e3 [input type=\"email\"] placeholder=\"Email\"\n  @e4 [input type=\"password\"] placeholder=\"Password\"\n  @e5 [button type=\"submit\"] \"Continue\"\n  @e6 [link] \"Forgot password?\"\n"}],"details":{}}}

E13 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/routes.js:27–53

defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 规范化 accessPath、校验 accessMode、拆出 uploadOne/uploadMany 并组装 exposure，是上传/元数据路由的公开装配入口。

export function defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes(options) {
    const paths = [];
    const entries = options.repositories.map((entry) => {
        const accessPath = normalizeAccessPath(entry.accessPath ?? `/uploads/${entry.name}`);
        if (paths.some((path) => path === accessPath ||
            path.startsWith(`${accessPath}/`) ||
            accessPath.startsWith(`${path}/`)))
            throw new Error(`Conflicting file accessPath: ${accessPath}`);
        paths.push(accessPath);
        if (!entry.disk)
            throw new Error('File repository disk is required.');
        if (entry.accessMode !== undefined &&
            !['stream', 'redirect'].includes(entry.accessMode))
            throw new Error('Invalid file accessMode.');
        const { uploadOne, uploadMany, ...actions } = entry.actions;
        for (const upload of [uploadOne, uploadMany]) {
            if (upload === undefined)
                continue;
            if (!upload ||
                typeof upload !== 'object' ||
                Object.keys(upload).some((key) => key !== 'maxSize'))
                throw new Error('Invalid upload action configuration.');
            if (upload.maxSize !== undefined &&
                (!Number.isSafeInteger(upload.maxSize) || upload.maxSize <= 0))
                throw new Error('maxSize must be a positive safe integer.');
        }
        return { ...entry, accessPath, actions, uploadOne, uploadMany };

export const FILE_COLUMNS = [
    'id',
    'disk',
    'key',
    'filename',
    'ext',
    'mimeType',
    'size',
    'createdAt',
    'updatedAt',
];
/**
 * The Policy the upload path binds, derived from the exposure's own.
 *
 * It is derived rather than used as it stands because an upload supplies no
 * caller fields at all — `store()` composes every value — so a field allowlist
 * has nothing to constrain here and the plugin substitutes its own columns.
 * What is inherited is exactly the two dimensions that do not describe caller
 * input: which rows this principal may produce (`scope`), and what the server
 * stamps onto them (`defaults`). A `create` that is `false` stays `false`, so
 * an exposure that forbids creating rows forbids uploading them too.
 *
 * This is the only place a Policy is widened, and the reason is specific to
 * this path. It licenses nothing elsewhere.
 */
export function uploadPolicy(base) {
    const create = base.create === true || base.create === false
        ? base.create
        : {
            scope: base.create.scope,
            defaults: base.create.defaults,
            fields: FILE_COLUMNS,
            relations: {},
        };
    // `read` serves this path's own returning record and the public byte route,
    // both of which need every column. `update` and `delete` never run here.
    return {
        create,
        read: { scope: true, fields: FILE_COLUMNS, relations: {} },
        update: false,
        delete: false,
    };
}

The fields are fixed; mapping is unsupported. The primary key must accept a 36-character UUID, string fields accept string/char/text, size accepts integer/bigInt, and timestamps accept datetime/datetimeTz. Apply with the App's migration command. Never import a live collection schema from a migration.

Upload generates the ID and storage key, normalizes the filename/extension, validates stored size, and supplies timestamps. E21 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:118–126

SKILL 说明上传 Policy 派生、contentUrl 规则，并声明内容路由是公开例外；要求在各贡献自有路径注册应用鉴权、禁止 contribution router 的 router.use('*')，但未给出前置中间件的具体 API。

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

FileUploadField takes a repository and controlled value/onChange; onStatusChange reports idle/uploading/error so forms can prevent incomplete submissions. Accept/maxSize/maxFiles are UI checks. removeOnDelete calls deleteOne, deleting metadata only; otherwise removal unlinks the selection. Read-only FileList, FileThumbnail, FilePreviewField and FilePreviewDialog use contentUrl without a repository prop. Import UI types from the installed recipe. Supply translated labels and adapt App-owned source as needed.

### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

## Verify and handle failures

Verify upload → query → contentUrl → identical downloaded bytes, including batch upload, resource aliases and host prefixes. After materialization run the consuming App's typecheck/build and exercise upload, cancel/retry, remove, download and preview. Restricted files need anonymous, forbidden-user and permitted-user tests against both API and content routes. Inspectors check registration only.

For preview integration or changes, verify each of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX with real files in development and a served production build. Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.

    url ?? (isSafeImagePreview(file) ? (file.contentUrl ?? '') : ''),
  );
  return imageUrl ? (
    <img
      data-slot='file-thumbnail'
      src={imageUrl}
      alt={alt}
      className='h-full w-full object-cover'
    />
  ) : (

{"type":"tool_execution_update","toolCallId":"call_01_QkAmiyy0hLoHodlmFA829353","toolName":"bash","args":{"command":"cd /home/runner/work/nb3-factory/nb3-factory/workspace && sed -n '1,200p' .agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md","timeout":30},"partialResult":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"---\nname: nocobase-app-plugin-file\ndescription: Add file collections, uploads, downloads, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX previews, business attachments, and editable Registry file components to a NocoBase 3 App using the public File Repository services.\n---\n\n# Add files to an App\n\nUse `@nocobase/app-plugin-file/server` and `@nocobase/app-plugin-file/client`. The plugin provides Repository managers, service tokens, route helpers, and the component-ui Registry recipe. The App or business plugin owns collections, migrations, Drive configuration, resource routes, permissions, and pages.\n\nInspect the App's existing registrations, migrations, disks, and resources first. Register the Server default export and the Client default factory before consumers, using the App's plugin lifecycle commands. The core does not create collections or routes.\n\n## Find and reuse the preview UI first\n\nInspect `client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/` before writing upload or preview components. Current Default templates preinstall this application-owned Registry source and its client dependencies; older applications and other templates may not. Import from its `index.ts`, not from plugin-internal paths. Registering the plugin supplies services and translations; it does not automatically install or upgrade the copied UI.\n\n| Format                                               | Registry preview                  | Content access                                                                 |\n| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |\n| DOCX / XLSX / PPTX                                   | Local `@silurus/ooxml` viewer     | Same-origin session credentials; no public URL or third-party service required |\n| Raster image / PDF / text / Markdown / audio / video | Built-in preview components       | See the content access rules below                                             |\n| Legacy DOC / XLS / PPT and OpenDocument              | Office Online fallback            | Internet-accessible absolute URL; cannot use the App session                   |\n| Unsupported or unsafe active content                 | Explanation and optional download | Download still requires permission                                             |\n\nFor custom attachment lists, uploads or business associations, reuse `FilePreviewDialog` with file records and `contentUrl`; it requires no repository prop. Extend the existing UI or add the necessary content adapter rather than reimplementing format detection and dropping supported formats. A DOCX download fallback indicates a request/rendering failure or an outdated/custom component, not that the plugin lacks DOCX support. Report the actual failure and preserve its evidence.\n\nIf the installed package, synchronized Skill and copied UI disagree, inspect the resolved plugin version, run `pnpm skills:sync` to refresh guidance, and reconcile the UI source separately. Skills synchronization does not upgrade Registry copies.\n\n## Work incrementally\n\n- Use standard File Repository routes, the Client File Repository and Registry components for new attachment features. Save associations through the existing business API, whether standard CRUD or custom routes; do not migrate working business routes just to add files.\n- Extend existing services, middleware, response adapters or installed UI components where needed. A necessary compatibility handler should delegate to File Repository; do not rebuild upload, storage and metadata handling with Drive or replace the whole CRUD stack.\n- Inspect the App's registration, collection, disk and business save path together. Reuse what works; do not ask the user to choose an implementation or repeatedly explore source when the documented contract suffices.\n- Verify one small upload → metadata query → content download before building UI. Then wire the returned IDs into the existing save/detail flow. Retain uploaded IDs if the business save fails, and run the affected checks after edits stabilize.\n\nThe following business example uses collection `invoice_files`, resource `invoiceAttachments`, connection `main`, and disk `local`. Adapt these to the App.\n\n## Collection\n\nCreate an App-owned, self-contained migration under `database/main/migrations/` with a unique name matching its filename. Replace `main` with the target connection when needed:\n\n```ts\nimport { defineMigration, type MigrationDefinition } from '@nocobase/db';\n\nconst migration: MigrationDefinition = defineMigration({\n  name: '202609080001_create_invoice_files',\n  async up({ builder }) {\n    await builder.createCollection('invoice_files', (collection) => {\n      collection.uuid('id').primary().notNull();\n      collection.string('disk', { length: 255 }).notNull();\n      collection.text('key').notNull();\n      collection.text('filename').notNull();\n      collection.string('ext', { length: 32 }).notNull();\n      collection.string('mimeType', { length: 255 }).notNull();\n      collection.bigInt('size').notNull();\n      collection.datetime('createdAt').notNull();\n      collection.datetime('updatedAt').notNull();\n    });\n  },\n  async down({ builder }) {\n    await builder.dropCollection('invoice_files');\n  },\n});\nexport default migration;\n```\n\nThe fields are fixed; mapping is unsupported. The primary key must accept a 36-character UUID, string fields accept string/char/text, size accepts integer/bigInt, and timestamps accept datetime/datetimeTz. Apply with the App's migration command. Never import a live collection schema from a migration.\n\nUpload generates the ID and storage key, normalizes the filename/extension, validates stored size, and supplies timestamps. Extra required columns need defaults because upload accepts no business values. `contentUrl` is derived, never persisted. Save returned file IDs through an App-owned relation or link table when submitting the business form; upload and form submission are separate commits.\n\n## API routes\n\nDeclare in the App or business plugin's Server routes module and merge both returned contributions into its existing routes:\n\n```ts\nimport { defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-file/server';\n\nconst fileRoutes: ReturnType<typeof defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes> =\n  defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes({\n    repositories: [\n      {\n        name: 'invoiceAttachments',\n        collection: 'invoice_files',\n        connection: 'main',\n        disk: 'local',\n        accessPath: '/uploads/invoices',\n        accessMode: 'stream',\n        policy: {\n          read: {\n            scope: true,\n            fields: [\n              'id',\n              'filename',\n              'ext',\n              'mimeType',\n              'size',\n              'createdAt',\n              'updatedAt',\n            ],\n          },\n          create: { scope: true },\n          update: false,\n          delete: { scope: true },\n        },\n        actions: {\n          findMany: { maxLimit: 100 },\n          findOne: {},\n          deleteOne: {},\n          uploadOne: { maxSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024 },\n          uploadMany: { maxSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 },\n        },\n      },\n    ],\n  });\nexport default fileRoutes;\n```\n\n`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.\n\nOnly declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.\n\n`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` "}],"details":{}}}
